_why: Row 2924: `h_mad_failure_diff.py run --subject-snapshot` measures a detached worktree at the subject's HEAD so the live checkout may change during the run; `--include-dirty` copies every path that differs from HEAD. Each mutant measures the live tree again, drops one class of dirty path, stops refusing a dirty tree, imports live code through PYTHONPATH, or leaks the snapshot.
command: snapshot or live_writer or include_dirty or suite_at

mutations.name: snapshot-runs-the-live-tree
mutations._mechanism: The subject side runs in the live checkout again, so an edit there during the run is measured (or trips subject-changed).
mutations.find: for side, root in (("subject", measured), ("control", control)):  # M:FD-SNAP-MEASURED
mutations.replace: for side, root in (("subject", subject), ("control", control)):  # M:FD-SNAP-MEASURED

mutations.name: dirty-files-are-not-copied
mutations._mechanism: Modified, staged and untracked files are not copied in, so the snapshot measures HEAD while claiming the dirty tree.

mutations.name: deletions-are-not-applied
mutations._mechanism: A file deleted in the live tree survives in the snapshot and is measured.

mutations.name: staged-only-changes-are-missed
mutations._mechanism: Diffing against the index instead of HEAD drops a change that is staged and not modified since.

mutations.name: dirty-tree-is-not-refused
mutations._mechanism: Without --include-dirty a dirty tree is measured at HEAD silently instead of refused.
mutations.find: if dirty and not args.include_dirty:  # M:FD-SNAP-DIRTY-REFUSE

mutations.name: snapshot-keeps-the-live-pythonpath
mutations._mechanism: An absolute PYTHONPATH entry inside the live tree is not rebased, so the snapshot imports the live code.

mutations.name: snapshot-is-never-removed
mutations._mechanism: The snapshot worktree is left behind and its leak is never reported.
mutations.find: snap_removed = snap is None or _remove_control(  # M:FD-SNAP-REMOVE

mutations.name: suite-at-runs-live-subject-instead-of-worktree
mutations._mechanism: If suite-at runs pytest in the live subject instead of the detached worktree, it measures the wrong commit and dirty live files.
mutations.find: reason, rc, output = _run_one(argv, wt, env, args.timeout, log)  # M:FD-SUITEAT-ROOT
mutations.replace: reason, rc, output = _run_one(argv, subject, env, args.timeout, log)  # M:FD-SUITEAT-ROOT

mutations.name: suite-at-skips-copying-dirty-files
mutations._mechanism: With --include-dirty, suite-at drops uncommitted changes and measures the bare commit instead.

mutations.name: suite-at-never-removes-worktree
mutations._mechanism: The throwaway worktree created by suite-at is leaked on disk.
mutations.find: wt_removed = _remove_control(subject, wt, admin[0] if admin else None)  # M:FD-SUITEAT-REMOVE
